### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-security`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s).

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **17** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `86aa22a26f303241465cf18f1831f8216b433d4a` — the merge of head `29c358576aa95cc4463f0cf1b616609dd81a113f` into base `5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 86aa22a26f303241465cf18f1831f8216b433d4a && git checkout 86aa22a26f303241465cf18f1831f8216b433d4a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132 29c358576aa95cc4463f0cf1b616609dd81a113f && git checkout -B drift-repro 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132 && git merge --no-ff 29c358576aa95cc4463f0cf1b616609dd81a113f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5517005d3a53600300f5cb8974ae20f178b63132` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `29c358576aa95cc4463f0cf1b616609dd81a113f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts (one list entry on `organization_admin.systemPermissions` + comment), its holders/derivation pins (default-permission-sets.test.ts), four grant goldens (boot positions, name equivalence, grant readers, resolver), packages/runtime automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts (own-org admitted / other-org refused per verb) and packages-capability-gate.test.ts, content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx (connect paragraph), .changeset/28427-org-admin-connector-connections.md (`@objectstack/plugin-security` patch). 10 files, +92/−33. Part of #28427 (maintainer-direct card; claim 6545275282; dev report 6545987804); the ADR-0143 D5 line is split out as a Tier H patch for the seat.
Inputs: card #28427 body + claim + dev report, ruling record 6545223261 on #28327, the PR body, the PR diff at this head, `git grep` on `origin/main` at the merge-base `5da3a8ce` (`deriveWallLessOrgAdmin`, `refuseUngrantedConnectorConnectionAccess`, `grantAppliesInTenant`; main's one later connectors.mdx hunk is at L415, this PR's at L516 — merge clean), check-runs (read 2026-10-31T16:49Z: all 50 latest-per-name check-runs completed, 36 success + 14 skipped, none failed, none running) — 50 checks. Nothing built or run here; the seat's numbers (plugin-security 238 files / 5126, runtime 496 / 8972, two ablations 17/93 and 4/4, 92 derived gates) are the dev report's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **One line, two sets, as ruled.** `manage_connector_connections` joins `organization_admin.systemPermissions`; `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` (main L1572-1577) spreads `...base` and strips only the wildcard `viewAllRecords`/`modifyAllRecords`, so `organization_admin_no_bypass` carries it from the same literal — the derivation-equality pin keeps it that way. No other shipped set moves (holders pin: exactly `admin_full_access`, `organization_admin`, `organization_admin_no_bypass`).
- **Scope is the organization, by existing machinery.** The capability is `org`-scoped (spec capabilities.ts, unchanged); core applies an organization-scoped grant only in the grant row's organization (`grantAppliesInTenant`, resolve-authz-context.ts L914); the door (automation.ts L952-958, L3101) reads `systemPermissions` fail-closed with only `isSystem` bypassing and hands the service the caller's own `tenantId`. The door test pins own-org 200 with `tenantId: 'org_a'` and other-org 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the capability, on GET/POST/DELETE/callback. Nothing in `packages/runtime/src` or `packages/spec` changes.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` — who the connection door admits widens; `Metadata-protocol: none` — no served key or shape. The `patch` bump on `@objectstack/plugin-security` is the seat's convention call (a default-grant change is behaviour, not surface); not a contract matter.
- **Agent reach is a consequence, not a change.** `assembleExecutionContext` passes the human's `systemPermissions` to an OAuth agent with `actions:execute` on main already (platform admins' agents reach the door today); the goldens show the organization admin's agent gaining the capability through that one path. The PR names this and leaves "should the door refuse an agent principal" to the seat — correctly outside ruling B.
- **Docs.** connectors.mdx now says platform and organization administrators hold it by default; permission-sets.mdx's summary row is left (already a subset). Three `packages/spec` comments that ruling B makes false (capabilities.ts L103-110, eval-user.zod.ts L166-169, platform-admin-capabilities.test.ts L52-54) are named and handed to the spec lane after merge — prose only, no behaviour.

### ② Rulings cited

- Tesla 「同意」 15:10Z to decisions item 6 = **B**, recorded 6545223261 on #28327: grant `organization_admin` + `organization_admin_no_bypass` by default before S4. Card #28427 filed by the maintainer's direct dispatch. Tier S here (the D5 ADR line split to its own Tier H PR); the seat lands.

### ③ Narrowing / widening

- Widening only: holders of the two shipped sets are admitted at the door in their own organization. No refusal added; no served document changes meaning.

### ④ Behaviour / flags

- Follow-ups owed, not blocking: the ADR-0143 D5 one-line PR (Tier H, closes the card); the three spec comment corrections (spec lane); the agent-principal question (seat).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jtzyzv`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`
**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组织管理员（包括无越权变体）默认持有「管理连接器连接」能力，只在自己的组织内有效，可以连接、重连、撤销本组织的 OAuth 连接器。改动只是一行权限列表，加上相应的测试和文档。
- 为什么改：你在 15:10 对决裁清单第 6 项的「同意」（裁定 B）：在 S4 控制台「连接」按钮上线之前，就让组织管理员能直接连接。
- 风险与回滚：其他内置权限集不变；跨组织仍然拒绝（已有测试钉住）。回滚即 revert，回到只有平台管理员持有。
- 先看：`plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` 中 `organization_admin` 的 `systemPermissions`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts`，全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。ADR-0143 D5 的记录行另开一个小 PR，需要 os-zhuang 批准。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS。代理人（agent）代组织管理员调用这扇门的问题不在裁定 B 范围内，已另交决裁清单（#435 第 1 项），不挡本 PR。可以直接落地。
